Health Economics Ontologies · HEO 2.0.0

Health Economics Ontology (HEO)

1,294 concepts on this page.


Obesity Economics

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/obesity-economics · HE-PE-CD-037

The application of health economic evaluation to obesity prevention and treatment, spanning lifestyle intervention, medication, and bariatric surgery.

Also known as Economics of Obesity
Is a type of Chronic Disease Economics
altLabel Economics of Obesity
Evaluates Lifestyle Intervention (machine-reviewed)
hiddenLabel Obesity Cost of Illness
identifier HE-PE-CD-037
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Dictionary entry, not yet expert verified
source Drummond MF, Sculpher MJ, Claxton K, Stoddart GL, Torrance GW. Methods for the Economic Evaluation of Health Care Programmes. 4th ed. Oxford University Press; 2015.

Obesity Prevalence Rate

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/obesity-prevalence-rate · HS-SS_HSP-042

A measure of the proportion of a population classified as obese based on standardised body mass index criteria.

Is a type of Prevalence, NCD Risk Factor Prevalence
hiddenLabel Obesity Rate, Population Obesity Level
identifier HS-SS_HSP-042
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Dictionary entry, not yet expert verified
source WHO, Global Status Report on Noncommunicable Diseases

Objective Response Rate

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/objective-response-rate · HE-PE-OO-013

Objective response rate is the proportion of participants in a prespecified analysis population who achieve a complete or partial tumor response according to defined response criteria during the assessment period, with any confirmation requirement stated.

Also known as ORR; Overall Response Rate
Classified under Outcomes
abbreviation ORR
altLabel ORR, Overall Response Rate
date modified 2026-09-25
identifier HE-PE-OO-013
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
Measures Tumour Response (machine-reviewed)
optional concept in step-1external
review status Expert verified
source Eisenhauer et al. 2009
Used to calculate Disease Control Rate (machine-reviewed)
verified by Dr Darrin Baines
versionInfo 1.0.0

Oblique Rotation

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/oblique-rotation · HE-ES-SA-141

A factor analysis technique transforming a solution into a more interpretable structure while allowing the resulting factors to correlate with each other.

Is a type of Factor Rotation
Contrasts with Orthogonal Rotation (machine-reviewed)
date modified 2026-09-25
hiddenLabel Correlated-Factor Rotation, Promax Rotation
identifier HE-ES-SA-141
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
optional concept in step-3external
review status Expert verified
source Kaiser 1958
verified by Dr Darrin Baines
versionInfo 1.0.0

Observational Data

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/observational-data · HE-ES-ES-030

Data collected without the researcher assigning participants to a specific exposure or treatment, instead observing naturally occurring patterns.

Also known as Non-Experimental Data
Classified under Evidence Source
altLabel Non-Experimental Data
Contrasts with Clinical Trial Data (machine-reviewed)
hiddenLabel Non-Interventional Data
identifier HE-ES-ES-030
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Dictionary entry, not yet expert verified
source Rothman KJ, Greenland S, Lash TL. Modern Epidemiology. 3rd ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins; 2008.

Observational Design

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/observational-design · HE-ES-CTM-058

A broad category of study designs, including cohort, case-control, and cross-sectional studies, in which outcomes are observed without assigning participants to an intervention.

Also known as Non-Experimental Design; Observational Study Design
Is a type of Study Design
altLabel Non-Experimental Design, Observational Study Design
Contrasts with Experimental Design (machine-reviewed)
identifier HE-ES-CTM-058
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Dictionary entry, not yet expert verified
source Rothman KJ, Greenland S, Lash TL. Modern Epidemiology. 3rd ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins; 2008.

Observational Study

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/observational-study · HE-ES-ES-031

A study that observes exposures and outcomes without investigator assignment of the exposure under investigation, using a specified design to describe patterns or assess associations and, under additional assumptions, causal effects.

Also known as Non-Experimental Study; Non-Interventional Study; Observational Research
Classified under Evidence Source
altLabel Non-Experimental Study, Non-Interventional Study, Observational Research
Contrasts with Randomised Controlled Trial (machine-reviewed)
core concept in step-1external
date modified 2026-09-25
Evaluates Exposure (machine-reviewed)
identifier HE-ES-ES-031
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
Produces Observational Data (machine-reviewed)
review status Expert verified
source Rothman KJ, Greenland S, Lash TL. Modern Epidemiology. 3rd ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins; 2008.
Uses Observational Design (machine-reviewed)
verified by Dr Darrin Baines
versionInfo 1.0.0

Observed-to-Expected Ratio

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/observed-to-expected-ratio · HS-NHS-HQ-045

A measure comparing a provider's actual observed outcomes against statistically expected numbers given patient severity, above one meaning worse than expected.

Also known as O/E Ratio; Observed-Expected Ratio
Is a type of Risk-Adjusted Measure
abbreviation O/E Ratio
altLabel O/E Ratio, Observed-Expected Ratio
core concept in step-5external
date modified 2026-09-25
identifier HS-NHS-HQ-045
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Expert verified
source Fetter et al. 1980
Uses Case-Mix Adjustment (machine-reviewed)
verified by Dr Darrin Baines
versionInfo 1.0.0

Observer-Reported Outcome

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/observer-reported-outcome · HE-ES-PRO-016

A clinical outcome reported by someone other than the patient or a clinician, such as a carer of a patient who cannot self-report.

Also known as ObsRO
Is a type of Outcome Measure, Clinical Outcome Assessment
abbreviation ObsRO
altLabel ObsRO
Contrasts with Patient-Reported Outcome (machine-reviewed)
hiddenLabel Proxy-Reported Outcome
identifier HE-ES-PRO-016
inScheme Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
isDefinedBy Health Economics Ontology (HEO)external
review status Dictionary entry, not yet expert verified
source U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Guidance for Industry: Patient-Reported Outcome Measures-Use in Medical Product Development to Support Labeling Claims. FDA; 2009.

Obsolete Technology

https://healtheconomics.wiki/concept/obsolete-technology · HS-HP-HS-014

A technology superseded by a more effective, safer, or more cost-effective alternative, such that its continued routine use is inappropriate.

Also known as Obsolete Health Technology
Is a type of Health Technology
